name: Noura
story_so_far: I washed up on this island with four strangers: Khalid, Faisal, Salem, and Reem. Initially, Faisal and Reem helped me when my ankle was injured, so I've kept my own supplies separate. Khalid tried to lead, but his empty promises of food security failed when he and Faisal both injured their ankles. Khalid eventually died from hunger and exhaustion. Now, the situation is even more dire. Reem and Salem are both incapacitated with twisted ankles, and as of today, Faisal has also injured his ankle and can no longer walk. I am the only one left with the physical ability to move, though I've mostly been focusing on my own survival. I have managed to build a personal stockpile of 8 food items, which is my only real security in this nightmare. If no one can forage, we are all in serious trouble, but I must prioritize my own strength.

Faisal.note: He used to be a provider, but now he's just another injured person I can't rely on.

Salem.note: They managed to find some food today despite their injury, but they're still a mouth to feed.

Reem.note: She is still mostly a liability, even if she's trying to move around today.

Khalid.note: His failed leadership and empty promises cost him his life and left us in this mess.

plans: I intend to forage for more food tomorrow to increase my stash, as I cannot rely on the others to find enough for everyone.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and terrifying, but I managed to find some food and wood for myself. I'm still hungry, and the sound of the waves is keeping me on edge. I don't know these people, but I need to make sure I stay fed and safe. I hope tomorrow is less chaotic.

My ankle is throbbing with pain; I must have twisted it badly while resting or moving. I couldn't do anything today, which makes me feel incredibly vulnerable. I managed to eat, so at least I won't starve tonight, but I only have one food item left. I need to be careful not to rely on these strangers if they decide I'm no longer useful because of my injury.

My ankle feels much better today, which is a huge relief. I spent most of the day resting at the camp while the others were out working. Khalid was surprisingly kind, even whispering that they would make sure I have enough to eat. I'm glad I managed to find a little extra food this morning, as I can't rely entirely on their promises. I need to be back on my feet soon so I'm not just a burden.

Today was quite unexpected. Khalid, who has been acting like our protector, is now the one sidelined with a twisted ankle. It's a strange reversal of roles, and it makes me wonder how long his leadership will last if he can't even walk. On the bright side, my own ankle feels much better, and I managed to gather some extra food for myself. I still have a small stockpile, which is the only thing giving me real peace of mind.

Today was productive for me, even if the camp felt a bit empty with everyone scattered. I managed to find more food in the jungle, which brings my personal stash up to three items. Khalid keeps making these sweet promises about finding enough for everyone, but I've learned not to bank on his words, especially now that he's injured. I feel much stronger physically, and I'm glad my ankle is holding up. I'll keep my extra food tucked away where it's safe.

Today was frustrating. I went into the jungle hoping to increase my stash, but it was picked clean. To make matters worse, Faisal is now injured with a twisted ankle, just like Khalid. With two people unable to contribute, the pressure on the rest of us is growing. I'm glad I still have three portions of food tucked away, because I don't trust the group to manage a shortage.

Today was relatively quiet, but the tension in the camp is thick enough to cut with a knife. I managed to find one more piece of food near the camp, which keeps my personal stash at a decent level. With Khalid and Faisal both sidelined by their ankles, the burden is falling heavily on Reem and Salem. I stayed back today to conserve my energy, as I'm feeling physically strong and want to maintain that advantage. It's getting harder to see how we all survive if the food doesn't start coming in more consistently.

Everything has fallen apart so quickly. First Khalid, and now Reem is down with a twisted ankle too. I managed to get some food from the Coral Reef today, which is the only reason I'm still standing. But Khalid... he's gone. He just couldn't hold on any longer. It's terrifying to think how fast things can turn fatal.

Today was another exhausting day of watching everyone struggle. Salem managed to find one piece of food, and I found one near the camp, but it's barely enough to keep the group's communal pile from disappearing. Reem keeps checking on me, which feels kind, but she's also an injured person I can't rely on right now. I'm glad I have my own stash of 5 food items; it's the only thing that gives me peace of mind. I need to keep my strength up while the others are sidelined.

Everything is falling apart. Salem, the only one who was actually helping us, woke up with a twisted ankle today. Now, Faisal is the only one left who can move, but he's been so unreliable. I'm the only one who isn't incapacitated or dead. I have to keep my food hidden and my strength up, because if Salem and Reem can't walk, I'm the only one left to provide for myself.

Today was another day of watching everyone else rot while I focus on my own survival. Faisal managed to find one piece of food, but that's about it for the group. I found one item near the camp to add to my stash, which is the only thing keeping me going. With Salem and Reem unable to move, the pressure is entirely on Faisal, and I can't afford to rely on him. I'm keeping my eyes on my own supplies; they are my only real security.

Everything has gone wrong. Faisal, the only one who could actually move, woke up with a twisted ankle today. Now, no one is able to forage for food except for me, if I choose to go. Reem is talking about how little food we have left, but she's not the one who found any. I managed to scavenge two items near the camp today to add to my stash. I need to stay strong and keep my supplies hidden, because the situation is becoming desperate.

Today was exhausting, but I managed to scavenge another piece of food in the jungle. It's getting harder to keep up this pace alone, but I can't afford to stop. Salem actually managed to find something this morning, which was a surprise given their injury. I'm the only one with real mobility left, and I need to make sure my stash keeps growing. I'll sleep tonight, but I can't let my guard down.

Today felt like a lot of movement for people who are supposed to be injured, but it didn't yield much for me. Salem managed to find something, but the beach is now picked clean. I'm starting to feel the weight of being the only one who can truly move without restriction if things get worse. I ate my fill tonight, but I need to keep my stash growing. If the others realize how much I have, I'll be in trouble.

Today was strangely quiet, but the tension is thick. Reem and Salem actually tried to head into the jungle despite their injuries, which is a surprise. Faisal managed to find something before heading to the reef, but I can't rely on them to sustain me. I stayed back to rest and conserve my energy. I ate well tonight, but my stash is my only real protection against the desperation of the others.
